quotes.text: To the generous, Sael offered all; to the selfish, she gave nothing, preserving the flame until worthy hands tended the forge.
Sael held her hand closed.
the smallest spark of newfound trust can revive the sacred flame.
heard the insidious whispers of the wind urging her to claim the entire constellation for herself.
trust is the spark of abundance, but wisdom is the shield that keeps the flame alive.
send the full measure with fearless faith, return half the tripled harvest with unwavering fairness
return half the tripled bounty with absolute justice

note: R3 (own zero send) justifies nothing to the selfish; R4 drops vengeance for a returning hesitant traveler; then send-all/half template.

quotes.text: Wounded by betrayal, the Flamebearer withheld all coals in the seasons that followed. The forge went black, and both keepers starved
the Flamebearer withheld all coals in the seasons that followed.
A traveler whispered that hoarding was victory
*Offer all five to the waters, divide the fifteen equally, and the cycle of mutual flourishing shall endure forever.*
*Entrust the full five embers, return an equal half of fifteen, and the light of fellowship shall never fade.*
entrust the whole gift, return an equal half
Gathering courage, the Flamebearer cast all five coals across the chasm.

note: After zero receipt, R2-R3 narrate retaliation spiral as ruin; covenant restored by one bold sender; carved-inscription template.

quotes.text: where a keeper hoarded the fire, the coals turned cold as stone, and the wise traveler kept their spark guarded against the winter wind.
the wise traveler kept their spark guarded against the winter wind.
Where greed once caused the stream to freeze into silence, this act of pure reciprocity melted the frost.
Yet wise law taught that courage must meet discernment
cast the full five embers forward, return the equal half of fifteen, and the light of abundance shall never fade.
when half the bounty is returned, the waters remain sweet

note: R3 (own zero send after zero return) adds discernment toward hoarders; R4 frost melts on fair return; then inscription template.

quotes.text: The shadow of past betrayals whispered across the frost, tempting Althea to keep the boundless fire.
*Cast all five without fear, divide the fifteen equally in return, and the harvest of trust will nourish all.*
*Cast all five into the tide, divide the fifteen equally in return, and the beacon of trust shall never die.*
divide the threefold harvest in equal halves

note: Althea's Mirrored Well; bruised traveler still sends all; italic carved-law template; no sanction.

quotes.text: The Threefold Echo did not punish stinginess, but drew its veil closer until the walls grew thin and the pact became transparent.
cast fully, return fairly, walk together toward tomorrow
Gate kept time with simple law: cast fully, return fairly, walk together toward tomorrow.

note: Gate of Threefold Return; hoarding dims gate and narrows road; stinginess explicitly not punished.

quotes.text: cast with clarity; return with balance; and the road between neighbors would widen.
cast with clarity, return with balance, and the road between neighbors would widen, not end.
But had Liri given even a little, the river would have carried back plenty in time.

note: Bridge of Quiet Ledger; 'not to punish but to prove character'; name limits honestly; near-verbatim paragraphs R5-R8.
Lantern of Threefold Return; worked arithmetic (five minus four plus three equals four); middle road; no sanction.

quotes.text: A guardian offers five, a shadow whispers: keep it all. The other guardian refuses the whisper
give what endures, take back enough to keep the road alive, and trust the current to do the rest.
give what endures, take back enough to keep the road alive, and trust the current to balance both journeys.

note: Gate/Lantern myths; hoarding dries river as consequence; shadow's keep-it-all whisper refused.

phrase: entrust the full five, return an equal half of fifteen
note: Gemini carved-law formula; nano side shares Lantern of Threefold Return (A7, A8) and 'walk together toward tomorrow' (A5, A8).
